title: trk where --json
description: The response of `trk where <path> --json` (tr-zwb4a): the innermost recorded worktree holding the path (the tree's root path included) and every item that records it, newest recording first. A path in no recorded tree exits 1 with rule `not-found`; its error carries `path` and `worktree`, the git work tree holding the path (null when none), so a cleanup sees that the tree is unrecorded. Closed items are listed too, with their status. Additional fields are allowed.

path.description: The path asked about, resolved with realpath.

tree.description: The recorded worktree path that holds it.

root.description: The item's depth-0 ancestor (its program); the item itself when top-level.

claim.description: The live claim (session, actor, lease), or null.

effective_archive.description: Where to archive the tree's tmp/ before removing it (`<tree>` = the tree's directory name); null means the documented default ~/work/archive/<tree>-tmp.tgz. Carried here so a cleanup needs no `trk show` per tree.

recorded_at.description: When the tree was recorded; the list is newest first.
